An '''emergency override''' was used within the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] type [[Seltaya-class fast courier|''Seltaya''-class fast courier]]. If one had problems with piloting the starfighter, one could use the emergency override and a [[Control tower/Legends|control tower]] would pilot the starfighter.
